name: Aaron Parton
headline: Analyst turned founder. I build AI automations, websites and ad systems that bring small businesses leads.
about: In May 2026 I quit my analyst job to go full time on Mycelium AI. Before that I spent five years building Power BI dashboards and SQL models for global companies. Now I build lead pipelines, websites, paid ads and AI agents for Australian businesses, from Pilbara contractors to a Perth speech pathology practice, and I open-source a lot of what I build.

experience.summary: Perth agency building websites, lead pipelines, paid ads and AI automations for Australian businesses.
highlights: Worked with 25+ businesses across trades, construction, agriculture, transport and allied health.
Grundy Drilling: 234 leads from $1,037 of Meta ads, $4.43 a lead.
Every lead pipeline texts the client and me the second an enquiry lands, and logs it to their CRM.
Automated Jaylon Industries' monthly Grain Storage Review: one write-up goes to Mailchimp, WordPress, LinkedIn and Facebook.

experience.summary: Procurement analytics for one of the world's largest aluminium producers.
highlights: Built Power BI dashboards and SQL models to track spend and supplier performance.
Found cost-saving opportunities across global operations.

experience.summary: Business analysis for a global agricultural services company.
highlights: Gathered requirements and built the reporting.
Turned operational data into clear decisions for stakeholders.

projects.title: Jaylon Industries: The Grain Storage Review
projects.description: A monthly technical briefing for Australian grain handlers, written, built and sent for them. One write-up becomes a Mailchimp send, a WordPress article and LinkedIn and Facebook posts. It goes out on schedule and costs their team no time.

projects.title: Dino Earthworx: website + Meta ads
projects.description: An earthmoving business in Toowoomba. New site they own outright, Meta ads and SMS lead alerts: 49 leads, page one for "earthmoving toowoomba", and $700 a month saved.

projects.title: Gibson Field Service: video content
projects.description: Short-form video for a field service business: 18,937 views against 822 before, 23x more people seeing their work.

projects.title: SwellVision
projects.description: Live surf conditions on your Garmin watch: swell, wind, water temperature and first light. Full Monkey C source, free on the Connect IQ Store.

faq.q: What do you build for clients?
faq.a: Websites, lead-generation systems and AI automations for small businesses, mostly trades and service businesses around Australia.
I was already building systems and dashboards for big companies. I wanted to build them for small businesses that can feel the difference straight away.

faq.q: How do I work with you?
faq.a: Email me at aaron@myceliumai.com.au and tell me what's eating your time. I'll come back with what I'd automate first.
